description: Rules for token use in PageSpecs (BASELINE R10). Category names are real keys of tokens/llm/token-catalog.json counts.byCategory, slot names are real keys of the PageSpec `tokens` object, and every `allow` entry is a real catalog path; extraction/verify_all.py (token-policy check) resolves all three. schema/semantic_validate.py enforces the TOKEN_* rules on every PageSpec.

notGenerationApproved.reason: Measured literal colours (overlay, focus rings, shadows, selection, placeholder, empty-state grey) are kept OUT of the brand palette by tokens/00-foundation/color.json itself. A PageSpec may not name them (TOKEN_NOT_APPROVED); verify_all.py checks this list equals the catalog's notGenerationApprovedCategories.

forbiddenRawValues.scope: hexColor and functionalColor are rejected in EVERY string of a PageSpec (copy included: a colour value never belongs in content). namedColorInTokenSlot and rawLength are rejected in token slots (TOKEN_RAW_COLOR / TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING). A font slot holding anything but a fontFamily catalog path is TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT.

rules.TOKEN_UNKNOWN: A token slot names a path that is not in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json.
rules.TOKEN_RAW_COLOR: A raw hex / rgb() / hsl() / named colour appears in a token slot or anywhere in the PageSpec.
rules.TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING: A spacing or radius slot holds a raw length (px / rem / em / % / vh / vw / calc()) instead of a token.
rules.TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT: A font slot holds a font name or stack instead of one of the two catalog font families (typography.font.display, typography.font.sans).
rules.TOKEN_SLOT_MISMATCH: A real catalog token of the wrong kind for its slot (not in the slot's allow list).
rules.TOKEN_NOT_APPROVED: A token whose category is not generation-approved (colorLiteral).
rules.TOKEN_THEME_COMBINATION: A token outside the declared theme's tokenScopes (auth.* under marketing-light, marketing tokens under auth-light), a theme that does not match the designSystem, or text/surface that the theme resolves to a contrast below minTextContrast.

pageSpecTokenSlots.$comment: Every token a PageSpec can name. `tokens.*` slots are the keys of the closed PageSpec `tokens` object (schema/pagespec.schema.json, generated from this list by schema/build_schema.py). nodeFill slots are the pre-existing per-node colour fields. `allow` is the closed list of catalog paths; the theme further restricts it by tokenScopes.

surface.purpose: Page background colour (marketing: the ivory .page-wrapper; auth: the flat shell).

text.purpose: Body text colour; must reach minTextContrast against the surface slot in the declared theme.

sectionPadding.purpose: Vertical section rhythm; a token, never a measured length.

cardRadius.purpose: Corner radius of cards and rounded containers.

nodeFillSlots.$comment: Pre-existing colour fields inside section content (blob / stone / shape fills). Their schema enums must be a subset of `allow` plus the sentinel; verify_all.py checks every contract's fill enum against this list.

themeRules.$comment: Pinned in code as PINNED_THEME_RULES in schema/semantic_validate.py and checked against this block by extraction/verify_all.py.
themeRules.themeMustExist: spec.theme must be a key of token-catalog.json themes.
themeRules.themeDesignSystem: spec.theme's designSystem (catalog themes.<theme>.designSystem) must equal spec.designSystem.
themeRules.tokenScopes: Every token a PageSpec names must have a themeScope listed in the theme's tokenScopes: marketing-light -> marketing + shared; auth-light -> auth + shared. The auth tokens must never be merged into the marketing set (and vice versa).
themeRules.themeResolved: A themeResolved slot may only name a token the declared theme resolves (themes.<theme>.semanticTokens).
themeRules.contrast: text resolved through the theme must reach minTextContrast (WCAG 2.x relative-luminance ratio) against surface. Rejects semantic.text.onInverse (#ffffff) on semantic.surface.page (#f8f6f5).

overrides: A PageSpec carries no per-instance style override. It declares a closed set of page-level tokens in `tokens` (validated here) and the pre-existing per-node fill enums; styling inside a section stays owned by the section/component contracts. Nothing else in a PageSpec can carry a colour, length or font.
